# CG-REQ-005: New optional request input

An optional parameter or optional request property was added.

**Why it matters:** Optional additions widen what the provider accepts.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Detects | `parameter.added`, `schema.propertyAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> New optional input in {where}{suffix}.
>
> Existing consumers can keep omitting it.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: optional parameter added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}, {name: sort, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. New optional input in GET /x: query parameter "sort".

### Fires: optional body property added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}, note: {type: string}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. New optional input in POST /x: the request body (application/json): "note".

### Does not fire: required parameter added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: q, in: query, schema: {type: string}}, {name: z, in: query, required: true, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: response direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {type: string}, note: {type: string}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
